usage.callShape: GET https://x402-geocoder-production.up.railway.app/geocode/address?street={street}&city={city}&state={state}&zip={zip} for forward geocoding; GET /geocode/reverse?lat={lat}&lng={lng} for reverse. Both cost $0.001 USDC on Base.
usage.outputShape: body.match (boolean), body.address (Census-canonical string), body.lat (number), body.lng (number), body.matchType (string or null), body.fips.{state, county, tract, block} (Census FIPS codes)
quirks: matchType field may be null even when match=true — always use body.match (boolean) to determine geocode success, not matchType
Rate limit is 60 req/min per IP (returned as ratelimit header: limit=60, remaining=N, reset=Ns)
Only geocodes US addresses; non-US addresses will return match=false
zip param is optional but improves match quality for ambiguous addresses
usage.guide: To forward geocode a US address, send a GET to /geocode/address with query params street, city, state, and optionally zip. To reverse geocode, send a GET to /geocode/reverse with lat and lng as decimals. Both endpoints return the same response shape: match (boolean), address (Census-canonical string), lat, lng, matchType (may be null even on success — use match instead), and fips object with state/county/tract/block codes. Payment is $0.001 USDC on Base via x402. Rate limit is 60 req/min.
